newsitem.title: GREECE: XIOSBANK KEEPS DEPOSIT RATES UNCHANGED.
newsitem.headline: XIOSBANK KEEPS DEPOSIT RATES UNCHANGED.

text.p: Xiosbank said on Monday that it would keep its deposit rates stable. Xiosbank reviews its rates weekly.
Its savings account offers an interest rate of 11.75 percent, the same as the savings plus account for sums up to one million drachmas.
The savings plus account pays interest of 12.00 percent for sums above one million drachmas, it said.
Its Xios-Alma deposit account offers annual rates of 12.68 percent and monthly interest payments.
The base rate for business credit was steady at 20.25 percent, the bank said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
